description: This file is a BitBake include (.inc) recipe for building Trusted Firmware-M for Cortex-M processors. It specifies dependencies, build configurations, and installation steps for the firmware project.

methods.name: python
methods.description: Checks if TFM_PLATFORM variable is set; skips recipe if not.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Runs CMake configuration with specified parameters.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Builds and installs the firmware using CMake.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Creates firmware directory and copies binaries.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: Copies firmware files to deployment directory.
